name: FTI Consulting Inc
business: Business advisory firm selling corporate finance, forensic and litigation, economic consulting, technology and strategic communications services to corporates, lenders and law firms worldwide.

events.what: New CFO appointed (external); overseeing finance and IT. MISSED by the Stage 2 sweep, which only saw the CEO contract extension
events.from: CFO and CAO, FTAI Aviation Ltd.; previously SVP Private Equity, Fortress Investment Group

events.what: Prior CFO resigned; Chief Strategy and Transformation Officer named interim CFO
New Chief Human Resources Officer; CEO Steven Gunby employment term extended to 2029-06-06 (no CEO change)
Two independent directors added, board 9 to 11; effective just before the 18-month window

next_event.source: Lexical search for 'investor day' across FY2026 FCN documents returned no hits; no Item 2.01 or 1.01 8-K since 2024-07-01

margin_framing.metric_basis_note: No margin level, rate or savings target found. Management frames recovery qualitatively around Economic Consulting (segment adj. EBITDA margin 4.7% in Q2 2026 vs 7.4%) and non-recurring first-half SG&A. Q1 2026 prepared remarks are attributed to Gunby in the transcript index but the text is Paul Linton (interim CFO).

statements.quote: Any given quarter can be funky, but go up in any medium term in our EBITDA lines and as well as our EPS lines.
statements.speaker: Steven Gunby

statements.quote: our adjusted segment EBITDA in Economic Consulting has hit its low point this quarter, as Steve said, we have multiple quarters of work ahead to get the P&L back to the levels we are happy with.
statements.speaker: Paul Linton
statements.role: Interim CFO and Chief Strategy and Transformation Officer

statements.quote: Despite the revenue growth, adjusted EBITDA declined year-over-year because of higher direct costs and SG&A expenses.
statements.speaker: Angela Nam

street.gap_assumption: No stated margin target, so no gap. Fiscal year ends December, so Baba FY labels equal company fiscal years. Street path is about +70 bps from FY2026 to FY2028 (10.93% to 11.61%), roughly back to the LTM level (11.17%).

evidence_of_progress.note: Order is [Q1 2026, Q2 2026]. Q1 2026 9.85% vs 12.82% (Baba consensus actuals). Q2 2026 adj. EBITDA $104.5M, 10.5% vs $111.6M, 11.8% (8-K EX-99.1 0001193125-26-328715, doc 142732), excluding $6.6M extraordinary litigation expense. 2026 EPS guidance cut to $8.70 to $9.30 on 2026-07-30. Margins still going backwards; the second-half recovery is a forecast, not evidence.

verdict: Mechanical 7 that overstates the setup: cheap at the bottom of its range with a new external CFO and flat estimates, but a 12-year CEO and no numeric margin framing to underwrite.
open_questions: Will the new CFO (ex FTAI, 5 months in seat) introduce a margin or SG&A framework, or is the role cost discipline and buybacks?
Is the Economic Consulting drag (segment margin 4.7% vs 7.4%) cyclical or a permanent talent loss tied to the litigation against a former employee?
How large and long are the extraordinary litigation expenses now excluded from adjusted EBITDA?

sources.title: Baba data_comps (market_data asof 2026-09-30, revisions asof 2026-10-01; ebitda_turn_pct -0.25%)
Baba data_guidance: no targets or guidance issuances on file
